snippet.title: Farm Vet / Mission Veterinaire
snippet.description: PC game developed by Espaço Informática Ltda. You'll play a vet apprentice, and treat several animals in the farm, in real cases, specially designed by pro vets. Mini-games, and a lot of fun.
